results.title: Tool use and function calling in language models
results.snippet: Models call external tools by emitting a structured call against a declared schema; the runtime validates the arguments, executes the tool and feeds the result back into the conversation.

results.title: Sandboxing and permissions for agent tools
results.snippet: Least privilege applies to agents as much as to processes: grant read-only access by default and require an explicit write permission before a tool may modify files.

data.task: How do multi-agent LLM systems stay reliable? Cover how they use tools, how tool permissions are sandboxed, and how agent workflows are evaluated.

## Overview
Multi-agent systems stay reliable by constraining tools, sandboxing permissions and evaluating outputs.

## Key Findings
- Tool use and function calling: a core reliability lever.
- Sandboxing and permissions for agent tools: a core reliability lever.
- Evaluating agent workflows: a core reliability lever.
